par2_dcf_path.description: Path to the PAR2 default configuration file.

compress_exclusion_case_insensitive.description: Enables case-insensitive mode for mask matching.

compress_exclusion_glob_mode.description: Forces glob expression mode for masks.

compress_exclusion_video_extensions.description: List of exclusions for compressed video formats.

compress_exclusion_animation_extensions.description: List of exclusions for compressed animation formats.

compress_exclusion_image_extensions.description: List of exclusions for compressed image formats.

compress_exclusion_audio_extensions.description: List of exclusions for compressed audio formats.

compress_exclusion_package_extensions.description: List of exclusions for compressed package formats.

compress_exclusion_data_extensions.description: List of exclusions for compressed data formats.

compress_exclusion_zip_extensions.description: List of exclusions for zip file formats.

compress_exclusion_other_extensions.description: List of exclusions for other specific compressed formats (lz4, zoo).

compress_exclusion_other_list_extensions.description: List of exclusions for other file types in alphabetical order.

compress_exclusion_blender_extensions.description: List of exclusions for Blender bake files.

compress_exclusion_dar_extensions.description: List of exclusions for Dar archive files.

compress_exclusion_case_sensitive.description: Swaps back to case sensitive mode for masks.

verbose_option.description: Option to show both skipped files and files being processed.

no_emacs_backup_glob.description: Forces glob expression mode for emacs backup exclusion.

no_emacs_backup_exclude_dot_tilde.description: Exclude hidden files ending in ~ (emacs backup).

samba_option.description: Samba file system timestamp handling option.

bell_option.description: Option to ring the terminal upon user interaction.

full_from_diff_option.description: Option string to rebuild a full backup from differential backup.
